by
  let ad_x := LieAlgebra.ad K L x
  let engel_subalgebra := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
  let engel_span := ↥(LieSubalgebra.engel K x)
  let h_linear_weights := LieModule.linearWeights K L engel_span
  let h_nilpotent := LieRing.isNilpotent K L
  let h_trace_form_eq_sum_finrank_nsmul :=
    LieModule.traceForm_eq_sum_finrank_nsmul K L engel_span (Module.Finite K L) h_linear_weights h_nilpotent h_linear_weights
  let h_char_poly_trailing_degree :=
    (LinearMap.charpoly.adjoint_charpoly_eq_trace_form K L ad_x).symm.trans $
    (h_trace_form_eq_sum_finrank_nsmul).trans $
    (Module.finrank_eq_dim K engel_span).symm.trans $
    (Module.dim_span_eq_finrank K engel_span).symm
  exact h_char_poly_trailing_degree
